verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਵਰ੍ਹੇ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ਵਸਿ ਜੰਮਦੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਕਿ ਲਈ ਉਦਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: baareh varhe garabhaas vas ja(n)madhe hee suk liee udhaasee|

en.bdb: Having remained in his mother's womb for twelve years, Sukadev adopted  detachedness right form the very time of his birth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਤੀਤ ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਹਠ ਬੁਧਿ ਨ ਬੰਦਿਖਲਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: maiaa vich ateet hoi man haTh budh na ba(n)dhikhalaasee|

en.bdb: Though he went beyond  maya yet because of his intellect pushed by stubbornness of mind, he could not attain liberation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਾ ਬਿਆਸ ਪਰਬੋਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਿ ਜਨਕ ਸਹਜ ਅਭਿਆਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: pitaa biaas parabodhiaa gur kar janak sahaj abhiaasee|

en.bdb: His father Vyas made him understand that he should adopt king Janak as his guru who is well grounded in the art of remaining in equipoise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਈ ਸਿਰ ਧਰਿ ਜੂਠਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸਾਬਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: taj dhuramat gurmat liee sir dhar jooTh milee saabaasee|

en.bdb: Doing so, and divesting himself of the evil wisdom,he acquired he wisdom of Guru and as ordered by his guru he carried left overs on his head and thus earned pats from the guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਜਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਦਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes aves kar garab nivaar jagat gurdhaasee|

en.bdb: When inspired by the teachings f the guru he repudiated ego, the whole world accepted him as guru and  became his servant .

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai paakhaak hoi gurmat bhaau bhagat paragaasee|

en.bdb: By falling at the feet, by becoming dust of the feet and by the wisdom of the guru, loving devotion came up in him.
As a gurmukh attaining pleasure fruit he got himself lodged in equipoise.
